what_this_round_added: four primitives the refused declarations had been asking for by name: uniq -i, uniq -d, uniq -D entered; sort -f was attempted and removed

sort -f / --ignore-case: eight candidate keys each falsified against the host, so it is refused by name (_SORT_FOLD_CASE_RECORD). Two lines equal under a case fold are ordered by something a folded key does not capture -- the same structural finding that removed sort -V.

the 2^30 sentinel in optimal_move's ranking leaked into the reported worst-case bound and printed 1073741825 for eleven surfaces; unsplittable shapes are now kept out of the ranking instead of scored.
two shapes added because refused declarations named the missing witness: lines_mixed_case and lines_case_runs

exactness.note: uniq -i keeps the first member of a run; uniq -d prints one line per repeated run; uniq -D prints every member

sweep.note: re-measured after the second sentinel fix; identical counts

why_a_v3: v2's 11 certificates did not include the four surfaces whose declarations named primitives missing from the algebra. Adding the three that could be specified exactly, and refusing the one that could not, is the same law applied twice.
